NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Info.name: UEnum_Info
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Info.description: Returns information about a UEnum and all its values. ALWAYS call this when working with a UEnum type to see valid values.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Component.name: SetVariable
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Component.description: Sets the value of a user variable on the component. This overrides the default value of a user-exposed parameter on a specific component instance.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Component.name: SetSystem
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Component.description: Sets the Niagara System for a component. Use this instead of setting the Asset property directly to ensure proper initialization.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Component.name: GetVariable
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Component.description: Gets the current value of a specific user variable on the component. This retrieves the current value of a user-exposed parameter, including any component-level overrides.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Component.name: GetUserVariables
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Component.description: Returns all user variable values currently set on the component. This retrieves the current values of all user-exposed parameters that can be overridden at the component level.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Blueprint.name: ConstructNiagaraBPWrapperFromSystem
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Blueprint.description: Creates a Blueprint actor wrapper around a Niagara System. This generates a new Blueprint actor with a Niagara component configured to use the specified system.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Blueprint.name: ConstructNiagaraBPWrapperFromComponent
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Blueprint.description: Creates a Blueprint actor wrapper from a Niagara Component. This generates a new Blueprint actor and preserves all component property values and user variable overrides.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: SetSystemData
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Sets property values on a Niagara System. Applies new values to system-level properties based on the provided data structure.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: SetStackInputData

args.stackInputRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}
args.inputData: NiagaraToolsetInstancedValue{struct, value: one of the allowed value structs}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Sets the value of a stack module input and returns the resulting stored value. Updates the value and configuration for a specific module input parameter.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: SetRendererData

args.renderer: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Sets property values on a Niagara Renderer. Applies new values to renderer properties based on the provided data structure. Payload shape varies with the concrete renderer class; call GetRendererSchema for the renderer's class to inspect valid properties before writing.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: SetModuleEnabled

args.moduleRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Sets whether a module is enabled. Disabled modules remain in the stack but don't execute. Current state is visible in module topology.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: SetEmitterData

args.emitter: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Sets property values on a Niagara Emitter. Applies new values to emitter-level properties based on the provided data structure.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: RemoveUserVariables
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Removes user variables from a system. Deletes the specified user variables from the system's user parameter collection.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: RemoveSetParameterEntry

args.moduleRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Removes a parameter from an existing SetParameters module by name. The module referenced by ModuleRef must be a SetParameters (UNiagaraNodeAssignment) module. Use bIsSetParametersModule in the module topology to confirm before calling.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: RemoveRenderer

args.rendererToRemove: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Removes a renderer from an emitter. Deletes the specified renderer from the emitter's renderer list.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: RemoveModule

args.moduleToRemove: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Removes a module from a script stack. Deletes the specified module and all its inputs from the script's execution stack.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: RemoveEmitter

args.emitterToRemove: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Removes an emitter from a system. Deletes the specified emitter and all its associated scripts, modules, and renderers.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetUserVariables
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns all user variables defined on the system. User variables are parameters exposed for external control and can be overridden per component instance.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetSystemSummary
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns lightweight system metadata: name, user variables, and one summary entry per emitter. Use this for first contact with an unfamiliar system. For full structural detail call GetEmitterTopology per emitter.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetSystemSchema
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns property schema for Niagara System. Describes all available properties and their types that can be set on a Niagara System.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetSystemDependencies
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns the four Used* sets (renderers, data interfaces, modules, dynamic inputs) gathered across all emitters and system scripts. These sets are not included in topology structs; call this endpoint separately when needed.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetSystemData
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns system property values. Retrieves the current values of all configurable system-level properties.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetSystemCompileState
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns the current compile state of a Niagara System: aggregate status, per-script compile events, and summary flags. Waits for any in-flight compile to complete before collecting.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetStackIssues
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns all stack issues (errors, warnings, info) from the Niagara module stack, including dismissed ones. Waits for any in-flight compile to complete before collecting.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetStackInputTopology

args.stackInputRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns stack input topology: name, type, visibility, editability. No value payload. For the resolved value call GetStackInputData. For a dynamic-input chain call GetDynamicInputChain.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetStackInputSchema

args.inputReference: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns schema for a single module input in the stack. Describes the type, metadata, and configuration options for a specific input parameter.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetStackInputData

args.stackInputRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns the value of a stack module input. Retrieves the current value and configuration for a specific module input parameter.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetScriptStackTopology

args.scriptRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns script stack topology: all modules and their inputs in execution order. All fields always populated.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetScriptStackInputValues

args.scriptRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns all resolved input values for every module in the given script stack. One FNiagaraExt_ModuleInputValues entry per module.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetRendererSchema
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns property schema for a specific Renderer class. Describes all available properties and their types for the given renderer type.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetRendererData

args.rendererRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns renderer property values. Retrieves the current values of all configurable renderer properties.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetModuleTopology

args.moduleRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns module topology: metadata and all inputs (name/type/visibility only, no values). All fields always populated.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetModuleSchemaFromAsset
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns schema for a module asset. Standalone function that doesn't require a system context - useful for browsing available modules.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetModuleSchema

args.moduleReference: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns schema for a module and all its inputs. Call this after seeing a module in topology to understand what inputs it exposes.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetModuleInputValues

args.moduleRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns resolved input values for a single module. Use when you need values for one specific module without walking the whole emitter.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetEmitterTopology

args.emitterRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns full emitter topology: four script stacks with all modules and inputs, renderer references. All fields always populated. The returned topology carries no input values; call GetEmitterInputValues in parallel. Note: mutation endpoints (AddEmitter, AddModule) also return topology structs — i...

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetEmitterSummary

args.emitterRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns lightweight emitter metadata: name, enabled state, sim target, renderer classes. Use this when you only need to check metadata without walking the full emitter structure.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetEmitterSchema
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns property schema for Niagara Emitter. Describes all available properties and their types that can be set on a Niagara Emitter.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetEmitterInputValues

args.emitterRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns all resolved input values for every module across all four emitter script stacks. One FNiagaraExt_ModuleInputValues entry per module, each carrying all its resolved input values. Call this in parallel with GetEmitterTopology to get both structure and values in two passes.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetEmitterData

args.emitterRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns emitter property values as a single JSON-string blob in PropertyValues. The blob contains the full FVersionedNiagaraEmitterData (SimTarget, bLocalSpace, RandomSeed, FixedBounds, etc.) — fields use C++ PascalCase, must be parsed to read individual values.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetDynamicInputSchemaFromAsset
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns schema for a dynamic input asset. Standalone function that doesn't require a system context - useful for browsing available dynamic inputs.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetDynamicInputSchema

args.dynamicInputReference: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns schema for a dynamic input module in the stack. Describes the inputs and configuration for a procedural value generator.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetDynamicInputChain

args.stackInputRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns the full recursive chain for a dynamic input: topology metadata and resolved values at every level. The starting input must have value mode Dynamic; an error is surfaced otherwise. The schema expands one full level and emits a typed recursion stub at deeper levels; the wire format recurse...

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetDataInterfaceSchema
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns property schema for a specific Data Interface class. Describes all available properties and their types for the given data interface type.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: GetAvailableDynamicInputs
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Returns all available Dynamic Input Module assets compatible with the given type. Dynamic inputs provide procedural value generation for module parameters.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: CreateNiagaraSystem
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Creates a new Niagara System asset. The new system will be based on the template system, inheriting its configuration and emitters.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: ApplyStackIssueFix
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Applies a Fix-style stack issue fix identified by IssueId and FixId. Link-style fixes are rejected. The fix is undoable via the editor undo stack. Applying a fix may trigger a recompile; the result waits for that compile to complete so post-fix state is valid.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: AddUserVariables
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Adds or updates user variables on a system. If a variable with the same name already exists, it will be replaced with the new definition.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: AddSetParametersModule

args.moduleLocationRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Adds a SetParameters module to a script stack. Unlike AddModule which requires a script asset, a SetParameters module dynamically assigns values to named parameters and generates its own internal script. Use this when you need to set one or more particle/emitter/system parameters directly in the ...

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: AddSetParameterEntry

args.moduleRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Adds a single parameter to an existing SetParameters module. The module referenced by ModuleRef must be a SetParameters (UNiagaraNodeAssignment) module. Use bIsSetParametersModule in the module topology to confirm before calling.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: AddRenderer

args.newRendererLocation: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Adds a renderer to an emitter. Creates a new renderer of the specified type and adds it to the emitter's renderer list. Returns an FNiagaraExt_RendererRef with the new renderer's Index and RendererClass, usable directly with SetRendererData / GetRendererData without a follow-up topology call.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: AddModule

args.moduleLocationRef: StackItemRef{system, emitterName, scriptName, moduleName, rendererIndex, inputNameStack[]}

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Adds a module to a script stack. The module will be inserted into the specified script's execution stack. Returns the module topology with all inputs walked (no input values — call GetModuleInputValues for values).

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.name: AddEmitter
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System.description: Adds an emitter to a Niagara System. The new emitter will be based on the template emitter, inheriting its configuration and modules. Returns the full emitter topology (no input values — call GetEmitterInputValues for values).

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Assets.name: GetNiagaraScriptDigest
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Assets.description: Returns the decoded asset-registry tag metadata for a Niagara script asset.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Assets.name: GetAssetDiscoveryInfo
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Assets.description: Returns the project's configured asset discovery groups. Each group describes a content directory's purpose and paths.

NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Assets.name: FindNiagaraScripts
NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_Assets.description: Searches for UNiagaraScript assets matching the given filters.
